title: EFC — Master Specification v1.1
abstract: Canonical master specification for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), defining the formal structure, notation, and baseline equations for three tightly coupled base layers: EFC-S (structural/halo layer), EFC-D (energy-flow dynamics), and EFC-C0 (entropy–information capacity mapping). The document provides a compact, mathematically explicit core that higher-level models, simulations, and epistemic layers can reference without ambiguity.
